name: Severalnines CCX MCP Server
description: Enables management of CCX database clusters through AI assistants, supporting operations such as datastore creation, scaling, and performance monitoring. It provides a comprehensive toolset for handling backups, database users, and firewall rules across various database engines including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis.

CCX_PROTECT.description: If set to 'false', destructive operations like deleting clusters or databases are allowed. These are blocked by default.

CCX_BASE_URL.description: The URL of your CCX deployment. For hosted service, use https://app.myccx.io. For self-hosted, use your instance URL.

CCX_PASSWORD.description: Your CCX account password (used for password authentication).

CCX_USERNAME.description: Your CCX account email address (used for password authentication).

CCX_CLIENT_ID.description: Your CCX OAuth2 client ID (created under Account > Security).

CCX_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your CCX OAuth2 client secret (created under Account > Security).
